resources.string: VPN Pinger\n\nCalls your URL every time the device\'s VPN connects, disconnects, or switches servers. You can additionally have it call the URL on a fixed schedule (see the periodic interval field). The monitor keeps running in the background as a foreground service (persistent notification) and auto-starts after every boot.

Interval must be a whole number of seconds between 0 and 86400 (24 h). Use 0 to turn periodic pings off.
